text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet. The urinalysis showing "Too numerous to count" red blood cells and positive leukocyte esterase but negative nitrites strongly suggests a glomerular source, such as IgA nephropathy or post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis, rather than a urinary tract infection or tuberculosis. Before I can confirm this, I need to know your age and if you have noticed any swelling in your legs or face. Please also tell me if you have a history of high blood pressure.
